findings.what: a secret-shaped NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable — compiled into the bundle
findings.fix: Rename it without the prefix and read it on the server only (§19.5).

findings.what: INBOUND_TOKEN is unset — flows cannot write to the app (closed), so a wired flow's writes fail
findings.fix: Set a 32-byte random INBOUND_TOKEN in the app's environment and in every flow's constants node (docs/import-sheet.md).

findings.what: DEMO_LOGINS on a pilot/production environment — the login page lists the demo personas and signs them in without a password
findings.fix: Unset it; demo personas are for the step-5 click-through on a demo deployment only.

findings.what: `BROADCAST.json` webhook has no authentication — anyone who learns the URL can run it (the URL itself is the secret: it lives only in the app's server environment)
findings.fix: Header Auth on the trigger with a secret the app sends from the environment; reject a missing/wrong secret in the first CODE node.
